name: FxCard
description: Card shell with six pointer effects (tilt, spotlight, glare, holographic, wobble, glass). Ref-driven, no re-render per move.

javascript.notes: Snippet-level port. React is the source of truth; no dedicated JS runtime.

vue.notes: Composition API snippet port. React is the source of truth.

svelte.notes: Svelte runes snippet port. React is the source of truth.

angular.notes: Angular @Input snippet port. React is the source of truth.

html.notes: Static markup snippet. Interactive behavior requires the React implementation.

tailwind.notes: Tailwind variant snippet, not a standalone component.

reactNative.notes: No hover/cursor on mobile; use press + haptics. Snippet port.

flutter.notes: Experimental snippet port; pointer interactions remapped to gestures.

swiftUI.notes: Experimental snippet port; pointer interactions remapped.

compose.notes: Experimental snippet port; pointer interactions remapped.
